name: CANOLAHONEY
source:
THIS MAY AT FIRST GLANCE SEEM EXPLOITATIVE OF THE CHILD

The characteristics features of CSA includes:
- Perpetrator seldom used physical force or violence; instead gain child’s trust and hid the abuse
- The perpetrator is usually a known, reliable or trusted caregiver.
- Perpetrators develops relationship with child over time as gradual process of sexualizing
- It often happens over weeks or years
- Occurs frequently as repeated episodes with increase invasiveness with time
- Most of the cases of CSA are interfamilial or incest.

[From [url=https://www.deaddeaddeath.red/canolahoney.html]website[/url]]
translation:
乍一看，这似乎是对孩子的剥削CSA的特点包括：
- 犯罪者很少使用武力或暴力；相反，赢得孩子的信任并隐藏虐待行为
- 肇事者通常是已知的、可靠的或值得信赖的看护者。
- 随着时间的推移，犯罪者与儿童发展关系，这是逐渐性化的过程
- 它通常发生数周或数年
- 频繁发生，反复发作，且侵袭性随时间推移而增加
- 大多数CSA病例是家庭间或乱伦。

[来自[url=https://www.deaddeaddeath.red/canolahoney.html]网站[/url]]
